The scheme of amalgamation is effective from January 25,2006.

The Federal Bank  Ltd has informed the Exchange that Central Government has issued an Order of Moratorium in respect of the Ganesh Bank of Kurundwad Ltd, Registred Office : Kurundwad, Kurundwad - 416106, Kolhapur (District), Maharashtra. The Federal Bank Ltd placed its interest to Reserve Bank of India for acquisition / merger of Ganesh Bank of Kurundwad Ltd with The Federal Bank Ltd. The Reserve Bank examined the proposal received from the Federal Bank keeping in view its financial parameters, retail network and synergies as well as strategic advantages. Taking into account the interest of depositors of the Ganesh Bank of Kurundwad Ltd. as well as the bank's strengths and weaknesses, the Reserve Bank has prepared a draft scheme of amalgamation of the Ganesh Bank of Kurundwad Ltd. with the Federal Bank Ltd and on January 09, 2006 placed in public domain a draft scheme of amalgamation of the Ganesh Bank of Kurundwad Limited with the Federal Bank Limited.

The Federal Bank  Ltd has informed the Exchange that upon the learning of the declaration of moratorium of Ganesh Bank of Kurundwad Ltd, in terms of section 45 of the Banking Regulation Act, 1949, the Board of the Bank at its urgent meeting convened on January 8, 2006 has resolved to convey to Government of India/Reserve Bank of India, its expression of interest in acquiring/merging of Ganesh Bank of Kurundwad Ltd with the Federal Bank Ltd..

attchmntText: The Federal Bank  Ltd has informed the Exchange that the Company Law Board Bench, Chennai vide their order dated February 04,2005 declared the following persons were declared as elected to the BODs of the Bank; "The results of the Poll in respect of the resolutions as announced by the Chairman of the AGM stand modified and the Bank is free to implement all the resolutions passed in the AGM". The Federal Bank  Ltd has informed the Exchange as follows : a) at the AGM of the Bank held on September 27, 2004, the shareholders of the Bank have declared a dividend of 70% on the paid up capital of the Bank, as approved by RBI to the eligible shareholders of the bank; b) Shri P C Cynac, Shri K P Fabian and Shri C J George have been elected as Directors on the BoD's of the Bank. Prof A M Salim who retired by rotation, and being eligible, offered himself for reappointment at this AGM was not reappointed. f) at the AGM of the Bank held on September 27, 2004, the shareholders of the Bank have declared for the issue of two bonus shares for every share held. g) Resolution for amending Articles of Association of the Bank in respect of Chairman and CEO's appointment which was a special resolution was not passed.
